title.narrative: Promoting Accountability and Education Rights (PAER)

description.narrative: The Action follows a rights-based approach (RBA). It strengthens the role of local CSOs in empowering workers, women, children and youth from vulnerable ethnic minority communities to promote and claim their rights, and promotes social accountability of local authorities towards these rights-holders. It is guided by the 5 RBA principles, and it promotes broad-based participation of the rights-holders in project implementation and decision-making concerning their lives
